title: Verify Node 24 SEO build and shared worker safety
summary: Local production-mode build, SEO tests and PostgreSQL concurrency passed. Read-only hosting checks refreshed; production rollout remains on hold.

changes.detail: Added Account 6 validation artifacts and approval-gated rollout report; closed the inherited manual-sync verification report.
Appended the verification report to the learning app history. Application behavior, typography, migrations, candidate source and disabled SEO scheduler were preserved; no removals.

validation.name: Node 24 production-mode build
validation.detail: Next.js 15.5.24 built release/seo-manual-20261018 with exit 0 and 228 generated pages. Uses placeholder service configuration and existing caches, not a hosted production build.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: Root no-emit typecheck, candidate build type validation and focused SEO/worker lint passed.

validation.name: SEO and worker regression
validation.detail: 30 SEO regression tests, 14 worker adapter/SQL integration tests, decoupled SQL suite and commerce SQL with injected SEO failures passed.

validation.name: PostgreSQL concurrency
validation.detail: Final native PostgreSQL 18.6 run passed single-run acquisition, stale-token rejection, SKIP LOCKED claims and stock writes while SEO locks were held. Initial initdb timeout failures retained.

validation.name: Read-only hosting and backup
validation.detail: Verified website deployment/project and Node 24, Hobby plan, 34 candidate hashes, both migration collision checks and backup checksum/full read/schema comparison. No secrets printed or production writes made.

validation.name: Production acceptance
validation.detail: NO-GO: backup was 172.2 minutes old; dedicated hosted worker, secrets, clean hosted build, actual RPC timeout, real admin/browser tests, monitoring and phase approvals remain outstanding. SEO cron remains disabled; no live preview certified.
